title: Jack et al. A Reengineered Hospital Discharge Program to Decrease Rehospitalization
access_depth: Full text methods and Table 3 reviewed
design_population: Single-center randomized trial; 749 randomized; 738 primary analysis
verified_finding: Combined ED visits plus readmissions IRR 0.695 (95% CI 0.515–0.937); readmissions alone IRR 0.720 (0.445–1.164)
limit: Bundled nurse advocacy/planning/education plus pharmacist call; single English-speaking safety-net population; not an isolated handout effect
relevance: Rationale for studying transitions; not proof that an HCAHPS composite causes fewer readmissions

title: Siddiqui et al. Does Patient Experience Predict 30-Day Readmission?
access_depth: Publisher abstract reviewed; PubMed abstract available in search; full text not reviewed
design_population: Retrospective single tertiary academic hospital; 10 years HCAHPS
verified_finding: Only 15.8% of readmitted respondents answered before readmission; these scores did not differ significantly from nonreadmitted patients
limit: Observational timing and response selection; cannot identify a communication intervention effect

title: Hydoub et al. Multisite analysis of patient experience scores and risk of hospital admission
access_depth: Full text methods and adjusted results reviewed
design_population: Retrospective cohort; 40162 respondents across 20 Mayo hospitals; 2016–2019
verified_finding: Discharge Information composite showed no association in the reported model; additional adjustment attenuated other associations
limit: Outcome is admission within 30 days after vendor receipt of survey rather than after discharge; selected respondents near hospitals
relevance: Directly cautions against combining non-equivalent outcome clocks

title: Richards et al. Patient-Reported Quality of Hospital Discharge Transitions: Results from the SILVER-AMI Study
access_depth: Full text available; methods and results review pending
design_population: Prospective observational cohort of older adults hospitalized with AMI
verified_finding: No quantitative result extracted until full methods/results review complete
limit: Condition-specific older population; not hospital-wide CMS ecological analysis
relevance: Relevant additional primary evidence; not used as support for pilot findings

title: Hospital-Level Nurse Communication and 30-Day Readmission in United States Acute Care Hospitals
access_depth: Publisher search excerpt; full page returned HTTP 429
design_population: Hospital-level CMS cross-sectional analysis according to excerpt
verified_finding: Excerpt explicitly includes discharge information as a secondary domain; no effect estimate reused here
limit: Full methods and supplemental tables not reviewed
relevance: Substantial prior overlapping research exists; do not claim novelty

title: Survey of patient experience HCAHPS
verified_finding: Rolling four-quarter hospital reporting with patient-mix and survey-mode adjustment
limit: Not the same population as a Medicare readmission denominator

title: HCAHPS Changes Survey Content and Protocol
access_depth: Official full PDF downloaded and text reviewed
verified_finding: Care Transition removed; updated content and administration modes
limit: Transition-period estimates require care; unchanged items do not imply unchanged administration
relevance: Do not pool mismatched survey constructs
